description: The bar chart illustrates the effect of different linguistic categories on various models, comparing mBERT-targ, XLM-targ, mBERT-permute, and XLM-permute across eight categories. The horizontal axis lists the categories in the order: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis is labeled "effect" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 40, with tick labels at intervals of 10. Each category is represented by a group of four bars, colored light blue, dark blue, light green, and dark green, corresponding to the four models as indicated by the legend. The bars for mBERT-targ and XLM-targ generally have higher values than those for mBERT-permute and XLM-permute, with the highest value observed for mBERT-targ in the IE-other category at approximately 33, and the lowest values for both mBERT-permute and XLM-permute in the Uralic category, at around 2. The chart includes error bars for each data point, indicating variability or uncertainty in the measurements. The categories are not sorted by the value of any specific model, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond the color coding provided by the legend.
